meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 控制浏览器，复用登录态提取所需数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用脚本控制 Chrome 完成自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to reuse logins and extract data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need scripted Chrome control for automation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 CDP 协议控制 Chrome 浏览器，复用已有登录态，执行打开网页、等待加载、读取页面文本、运行 JavaScript、点击输入、提取登录凭证等自动化操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“浏览器操作”“CDP”“复用登录态”等关键词，或要求控制 Chrome 做自动化时触发。启动前会先探测，若需关闭现有 Chrome 会先征求你的同意。

say.text: 用浏览器打开 https://example.com 并等待加载
say.note: 它会执行 open 和 wait 命令

say.text: 从浏览器里提取登录 token
say.note: 它会读取 localStorage 或 cookie

say.text: 点击页面上的登录按钮并输入账号
say.note: 它会先拍快照定位元素再操作

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a Chrome browser via CDP, reuse existing login sessions, and automate tasks like opening URLs, waiting for page load, reading page text, executing JavaScript, clicking, typing, and extracting auth tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "browser operation", "CDP", or "reuse login state", or ask Claude to automate Chrome. It first checks the environment and asks your consent before killing any running Chrome processes.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and wait for it to load.
say_en.note: It runs the open and wait commands.

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the browser.
Click the login button and type the account.
say_en.note: It snapshots the page to locate elements first.
